answer: Beacon-seeded haven delay bond: agents lock a 70-credit bond and file a vine-tagged delay proof, one serial hour from the beacon. The haven registry checks each proof instantly from the beacon log; each extra identity needs another hour, so the k-th fake costs 42+6(k-1) credits and 1,000 fakes pay 3,039,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Rented proofs fail: each is key-bound to its vine tag. An honest agent pays 42 once, keeps its bond.
